newsitem.title: JAPAN: Orix to buy part of Crown Leasing Japan portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Orix to buy part of Crown Leasing Japan portfolio.

text.p: Orix Corp said on Friday that it would buy a portion of Crown Leasing Corp's domestic financial portfolio.
Crown Leasing was one of the three financial affiliates of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd that went bankrupt.
Orix said in a statement that the book value of the portfolio, which includes loans and lease equipment, totalled 310 billion yen, but the purchase price had yet to be decided.
The company also said it does not know at this point the impact of the purchase on its earnings.
The deal is expected to be made in early July, the statement said.
Orix said that the purchase of Crown Leasing's portfolio will help broaden its client base.
Crown Leasing, along with two other affiliates, declared bankruptcy in April.
